text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — saw a flurry of Xid 31/63 on us-west1-gpu-87 overnight. Node got soft-tainted but many jobs lingered; autoscaler didn't preempt.
Zach: Same card that flaked last month?
Maya: Yep, probably the same PCI flake pattern. 4 Xid bursts over a 10m window.
Ravi: Current rule is `Xid>3 within 2m -> soft-cordon -> 30m grace`. That seems to oscillate.
Lee: Proposal: move to a health-gated operator. Trigger only when BOTH: (a) Xid_rate > 3/min AND (b) either ECC_mem_spikes OR PCI_reset_count > 0. Action: taint+evict in k8s, and call slurm-drain adapter for batch nodes.
Claire: Does operator read metrics from node-exporter or do we need vendor telemetry agent?
Maya: We'll pull node-exporter for Xid rate + nvidia-smi ECC counters; vendor telemetry if available as a secondary signal.
Maya: Prototype config:
```
health_gate:
  xid_rate: 3/min
  ecc_spike_count: 2
  pci_resets: 1
actions:
  k8s: taint=red-team:drain, evict=true
  slurm: drain=true, maintenance_tag=auto-fence
hysteresis:
  cool_down: 10m
  snapback_if_no_events: true
region_guard:
  max_region_drain_pct: 10
  evaluation_window: 1h
```
infra-bot: AUTODRAIN: node us-west1-gpu-87 autotainted at 2026-03-17T03:12:20Z; reason: XidRate=4, ECC_spike=1. Ticket created INF-8421.
Zach: Add hysteresis: if signals stop within 10m, auto-untaint; otherwise escalate to card-replace + reimage.
Ravi: Also add a region-aware gate: refuse >10% regional capacity drain in 1h and optionally failover to fallback-region. Cross-region bursts cost ~3x — include cost warning in rollout docs.
Lee: Slurm edge-case — long-running batch jobs can't be evicted instantly. Operator should call `scontrol update NodeName=<node> State=drain Reason='Xid spikes'` and attach maintenance tag; allow policy-driven preemption window.
Claire: I'll add chaos tests in staging to simulate Xid bursts and validate snapback/hysteresis.
Maya: Next steps: Zach -> PR for operator logic + hysteresis; Ravi -> Slurm drain adapter; Claire -> chaos canary. Rollout plan: canary on 5 nodes us-west1, monitor 48h.
Zach: Will open PR by EOD. Example k8s taint command: `kubectl taint nodes gpu-87 red-team=drain:NoSchedule`.
Ravi: Example slurm drain: `scontrol update NodeName=gpu-87 State=drain Reason="Xid spikes"`.
Maya: :thumbsup: Add notes to INF-8421 and ping on release. Thanks all.
